editorial.blurb: Noodleverse serves deeply satisfying hand-pulled noodle bowls in a cozy basement food court, where spicy broths and tender meats shine alongside complimentary pickled vegetables.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the signature spicy beef broth and pair it with their complimentary pickled vegetables—the sesame napa cabbage and radishes round out the dish perfectly and add refreshing texture.
signatureDishes: dan dan noodle with rich peanut sauce

topDishes.note: tender beef, perfectly spicy, springy noodles, generous portions
